messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Payment batch reconciliation and assignment failures",
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot reconcile payment batches because supplier ledgers and invoices are missing or inaccessible. Additionally, uploaded claim documents fail to auto-assign to the correct supplier tasks, disrupting the workflow.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "I’m trying to figure out why the latest payment batch didn’t reflect in our supplier ledger",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-09T15:46:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I’m trying to reconcile the latest payment batch with our suppliers’ invoices but can’t locate the matching documents in the system.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-30T09:52:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I’m trying to figure out why my latest batch of claims documents didn’t auto-assign to the right supplier tasks.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-10T10:12:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem statement describes two in-product issues: payment batches not reflecting in supplier ledgers and uploaded claim documents failing to auto-assign to supplier tasks. The quotes corroborate both: users cannot locate matching documents for reconciliation (2026-10-30) and documents fail to auto-assign to the correct supplier tasks (2026-09-10). These are functional product failures within Keelwater's software, not pricing, customer IT, or help-article issues, and a squad could act on them.", "verdict": "pass"}
